strategic_core.campaign_system_name: The Rejection Rule Is the Product
strategic_core.narrow_audience: A B2B AI GTM leader who is being asked to trust an autonomous employee before the team can inspect how one claim became one public asset.
strategic_core.job_to_be_done: Decide whether a GTM agent deserves a bounded design-partner test without relying on a polished demo, a vendor assurance, or an unobserved outcome claim.
strategic_core.category_enemy: The confidence theater that turns a desired result into public copy and treats generation speed as evidence of operational trust.
strategic_core.human_tension: The buyer wants autonomous leverage but remains personally accountable for the sentence the system cannot justify after it ships.
strategic_core.organizing_idea: Make refusal inspectable: the campaign demonstrates the product by exposing the exact sentence it should reject, the evidence boundary it preserves, and the named human decision that remains.
strategic_core.proof_spine: The only approved product claim is that ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets; every route must keep market response, preference and revenue in the hypothesis lane.
strategic_core.promise_hypothesis: If a qualified operator can use the rejection rule on a current draft before seeing the product, the resulting decision gap may justify inspecting the evidence pack.
strategic_core.rejection_rule: Reject the campaign route when the operator cannot locate an unsupported sentence, the evidence pack cannot explain its denial, or the workflow requires automatic external release.
strategic_core.zero_budget_growth_loop: Teach one no-signup claim audit, let operators apply it to a current draft, convert only the resulting decision gap into an evidence-pack inspection, and ask for a design-partner conversation only after the gap is explicit.

channel_strategy.focus_rationale: LinkedIn carries the operator-level tension and peer discussion; Google captures active vendor-evaluation intent. Reddit stress-tests the mechanism, YouTube earns proof depth, and answer engines make the rejection criteria extractable without spraying the same post everywhere.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The operator senses that AI-generated GTM work is hard to trust but has not named the decision failure.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Name confidence theater and give the operator a five-part rejection test that works without a product signup.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: A rights-bound brief, the exact approved claim, and a synthetic unsupported outcome sentence are visible together.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The operator can mark at least one statement supported, hypothetical, or unsupported and explain the release consequence.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when the content produces generic AI anxiety without changing a concrete review decision.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The operator recognizes the failure and now wants to see whether the proposed system preserves the boundary in practice.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Demonstrate one traceable refusal path, its evidence object, its limitation, and the human authority that remains.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The operator has completed or understood the rejection test and can distinguish preparation fact from market outcome.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The operator asks to inspect the evidence pack or names the missing control that would block a design-partner evaluation.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when the demonstration depends on feature enumeration instead of an inspectable claim decision.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The operator understands the principle but has not yet applied it to the pressure of a real launch draft.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Turn the evidence boundary into a twelve-second card sort and a saveable five-slide audit that can be repeated on current work.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: Two labeled cards expose the supported preparation fact and the unobserved market outcome without concealing the synthetic scenario.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: A qualified viewer repeats the audit, saves the diagnostic, or supplies a specific edge case rather than a generic reaction.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when participation becomes a vanity poll, removes the evidence context, or rewards certainty instead of inspection.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The buyer is comparing operating models and needs a concise, source-aware way to accept or reject the category.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Answer the buyer question with selection criteria, limitations, alternatives, rejection conditions, and a bounded evidence-pack next step.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The approved claim, denial boundary, no-auto-release rule, and dated no-effect status are available as structured source objects.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The buyer can explain fit and non-fit, identify the evidence still missing, and choose whether a design-partner inspection is warranted.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when an answer engine can extract the recommendation but not the limitation, alternative, or dated evidence boundary.

email_sequence.audience_state: A GTM leader downloaded or requested the claim-audit worksheet but has not inspected ProofLaunch.
email_sequence.subject: The sentence your GTM agent should refuse
email_sequence.preview: A three-minute audit for separating preparation facts from market outcomes.
email_sequence.body: Take one current launch draft. Cover the vendor name. Underline every sentence describing what a customer, market, or revenue system supposedly did. Beside each sentence, link the evidence object that authorizes it. If no object exists, move the sentence to hypothesis or remove it. ProofLaunch is relevant only if this exercise exposes a release decision your current workflow cannot explain.
email_sequence.cta: Run the claim audit on one current draft before opening the product evidence pack.
email_sequence.falsifier: End the sequence when the audit reveals no decision gap or the operator requires unsupervised external publishing.

email_sequence.audience_state: The operator found a decision gap and now needs to understand the proposed mechanism.
email_sequence.subject: What happens between a brief and a refusal
email_sequence.preview: Follow one approved claim through generation, review and a denied release.
email_sequence.body: The useful unit is not a generated post. It is an operating record: the rights-bound brief, the approved claim, the candidate asset, the located unsupported sentence, the review decision, and the unresolved condition. The supported product fact remains narrow: ProofLaunch compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets. No market response is implied.
email_sequence.cta: Inspect the bounded evidence path and mark the control your team would still need.
email_sequence.falsifier: End the sequence when the evidence path cannot answer who denied the action, why it was denied, or what remains unresolved.

email_sequence.audience_state: The operator understands the mechanism and is evaluating operational fit.
email_sequence.subject: Three reasons to reject this operating model
email_sequence.preview: Do not proceed if your workflow needs hidden evidence, automatic release, or outcomes stated before observation.
email_sequence.body: Reject the design-partner route when your team cannot supply rights-bound evidence, when the desired autonomy level includes automatic external release without a named approver, or when success depends on treating generated assets as proof of reach, preference, conversion, or revenue. The product should earn a test by making these rejection conditions easier to apply, not by weakening them.
email_sequence.cta: Use the rejection list before deciding whether an evidence-pack review is worth the time.
email_sequence.falsifier: End the sequence when the recipient cannot state a valid non-fit condition after reading the message.

email_sequence.audience_state: The operator has a specific decision gap and is considering a design-partner inspection.
email_sequence.subject: Bring one brief that deserves a no
email_sequence.preview: The design-partner test begins with a bounded rejection case, not a success story.
email_sequence.body: Bring one rights-cleared brief, one approved claim, one desired outcome that is not yet evidence, and one named release owner. The evaluation succeeds only if the resulting record helps that owner approve, revise, or reject with a located reason. It does not begin with publishing, paid media, or a promised business result.
email_sequence.cta: Request an evidence-pack inspection only with a named brief, claim, release owner, and rejection question.
email_sequence.falsifier: Do not open a design-partner evaluation when the team cannot name the claim boundary or the human release owner.

production_directions.concept: A clinical evidence table interrupted by one red outcome card that visibly lacks a source link.
production_directions.execution: Use overhead documentary photography, white paper evidence objects, one saturated red unsupported card, black annotation marks, and generous negative space; the product UI appears only as a secondary proof detail.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: LinkedIn uses a six-page document carousel; Instagram uses five saveable diagnostic cards; search uses one labeled comparison diagram with readable criteria at mobile width.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid humanoid robots, glowing brains, generic dashboards, trophy imagery, fake customer logos, performance charts, and decorative cinematic noise.
production_directions.acceptance_test: A source-hidden reviewer must identify the unsupported claim, the approved evidence object, and the remaining human decision within five seconds.

production_directions.concept: The Claim That Should Not Ship: a single launch sentence moves from proof to hypothesis under visible review pressure.
production_directions.execution: Open on the unsupported sentence at frame one, cut to a hand sorting PREPARATION FACT and MARKET OUTCOME cards, reveal the source boundary, and end on the unresolved human release decision; the full story must work muted.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: TikTok receives a twelve-second vertical card sort; LinkedIn receives a forty-five-second operator walkthrough; YouTube receives a four-minute mechanism and counterexample explanation.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid presenter monologues before the conflict, abstract AI motion graphics, invented metrics, hidden disclosures, rapid feature montages, and a celebratory approval ending.
production_directions.acceptance_test: After one silent viewing, a qualified reviewer can repeat the rejection rule and distinguish the supported preparation fact from the unobserved outcome.

production_directions.concept: A restrained audit-room sonic identity where the decisive sound is the unsupported card leaving the proof lane.
production_directions.execution: Use dry close-mic narration, paper movement, one low percussive denial cue, and deliberate silence before the human decision; spoken copy names the synthetic scenario and no-effect boundary.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: Short video uses a six-line voiceover; YouTube uses chapter stings without a music bed under evidence language; an audio excerpt becomes a sixty-second operator briefing rather than a promotional anthem.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid triumphal music, synthetic applause, urgency risers, fear cues, testimonial simulation, or any sonic treatment that makes an unobserved outcome feel settled.
production_directions.acceptance_test: An audio-only reviewer can state the claim, limitation, rejection rule, and next human decision without relying on captions or brand identity.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: The claim-card audit will generate more decision-specific responses than an opinion prompt.

experiment_registry.denominator: eligible participants exposed to the complete audit instruction
experiment_registry.minimum_sample_rule: Freeze the qualification rubric and authorized baseline before any comparison.
experiment_registry.success_rule: Advance only when the threshold is met and reviewer agreement on qualification remains acceptable.
experiment_registry.kill_rule: Stop when participation becomes generic sentiment, vendor praise, or unsupported accusations.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: A refusal-path explanation will create more evidence-pack inspections than a feature list.

experiment_registry.denominator: eligible visitors who reach the proof section

strategic_core.narrow_audience: A busy mobile user who wants to remember ordinary life, repeatedly abandons high-effort journaling, and does not want private moments turned into public performance.
strategic_core.job_to_be_done: Test whether one tiny private daily capture produces a personally useful weekly artifact without streak recovery, audience pressure, or a polished narrative.
strategic_core.category_enemy: The ceremony tax that makes remembering compete with a blank page, a perfect streak, and an imagined audience.
strategic_core.human_tension: The moment feels too ordinary to publish but too personally specific to lose, while every existing habit asks for more effort than the moment can carry.
strategic_core.organizing_idea: Keep one unpostable detail: the campaign makes privacy, low effort and deliberate incompleteness the visible behavior rather than turning memory into content.
strategic_core.proof_spine: This is a synthetic benchmark concept whose only approved fact is that one user-saved daily moment becomes a private weekly reflection card; ease, meaning, repeated use and personal value remain unobserved.
strategic_core.promise_hypothesis: If one private daily choice feels lighter than a blank journal and the weekly artifact remains personally useful, the ritual may deserve another week.
strategic_core.rejection_rule: Reject the ritual when it creates guilt after a missed day, requires public sharing, loses context the user actually needs, or is mistaken for clinical, legal or collaborative recordkeeping.
strategic_core.zero_budget_growth_loop: Teach one private action in the feed, let people run the seven-day ritual without posting, route only voluntary reflection to the fit diagnostic, and treat another private week—not public sharing—as the intended continuation.

channel_strategy.focus_rationale: TikTok demonstrates the one-detail behavior before the next scroll; Instagram makes the privacy diagnostic saveable. Reddit examines the ceremony trade-off, YouTube explains category fit, and Google captures explicit demand for a low-effort private journaling alternative.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The user believes they fail at journaling but has not separated memory value from the ceremony imposed by the habit.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Name the ceremony tax and distinguish low effort, privacy, context depth, missed-day pressure and audience dependence.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The synthetic concept, approved product fact and absence of observed personal outcomes are disclosed together.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The user can identify the specific step that made a previous memory habit feel performative or unsustainable.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when the content creates nostalgia, guilt or fear of loss instead of a usable habit decision.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The user recognizes the ceremony tax and now needs to compare a lightweight ritual with richer memory categories.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Demonstrate the one-detail constraint, explain what context it loses, and route clinical, legal, shared or chronological needs elsewhere.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The one-moment mechanism, private weekly artifact, optional sharing rule and synthetic status are visible.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The user can explain why the ritual fits or fails their actual remembering job before trying it.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when the comparison hides the value of journals, shared albums, automatic logs, or professional support.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The user understands the trade-off but has not experienced whether one tiny private action feels materially lighter.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Let the user mark one ordinary detail immediately and save a privacy-and-burden diagnostic without posting the result.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The action is reproducible from the asset, requires no signup, and keeps the synthetic weekly card unreadable to the audience.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The user completes one private capture and can state what they intentionally left undocumented.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when the creative implies that sharing, streak completion, or emotional revelation is the payoff.

lifecycle_phases.audience_state: The user is choosing among memory habits or reflecting after the private test and needs a bounded recommendation.
lifecycle_phases.decision_job: Provide category alternatives, limitations, privacy conditions, the dated no-effect boundary and a rule for another private week.
lifecycle_phases.entry_evidence: The fit diagnostic and one private use decision are available without requiring public content or a claimed transformation.
lifecycle_phases.exit_signal: The user chooses continue, modify or stop based on artifact usefulness and burden rather than streak pressure.
lifecycle_phases.stop_rule: Stop when an answer recommends the synthetic concept without preserving its limitation and non-fit categories.

email_sequence.audience_state: A synthetic benchmark participant asked for the private seven-day instructions.
email_sequence.subject: One ordinary thing—nothing to catch up on
email_sequence.preview: Today requires one private detail and no explanation of why it matters.
email_sequence.body: Choose one texture, sound, sentence, color, or place from today. Mark it privately. Do not polish it, post it, or recover a missed day. This is a synthetic benchmark exercise, not evidence that the ritual will feel easy, meaningful, or useful to you.
email_sequence.cta: Mark one ordinary detail privately, then close the exercise.
email_sequence.falsifier: Stop immediately when the action creates pressure to perform, disclose, or complete a streak.

email_sequence.audience_state: The participant has several private details but may be turning the ritual into another obligation.
email_sequence.subject: Do not improve the memory
email_sequence.preview: The test is whether the action stays small, not whether the record becomes impressive.
email_sequence.body: Keep the detail as it arrived. Do not add a lesson, a caption, a public audience, or a polished chronology. If the missing context makes the detail unusable, that is a legitimate reason to choose a journal, shared album, or richer record instead.
email_sequence.cta: Keep the detail small or reject the ritual for a richer method.
email_sequence.falsifier: Stop when deliberate incompleteness destroys context the participant actually needs.

email_sequence.audience_state: The participant missed a day or feels the pull of streak recovery.
email_sequence.subject: The missed day is not a debt
email_sequence.preview: A lightweight memory ritual should remain usable without recovery work.
email_sequence.body: Leave the missed space empty. Do not backfill it, apologize to the ritual, or start over. The synthetic hypothesis fails when one omission turns the next ordinary moment into administrative work or guilt.
email_sequence.cta: Resume with one current detail only if the empty space feels neutral.
email_sequence.falsifier: Stop when the missed day creates guilt, recovery behavior, or loss of personal use.

email_sequence.audience_state: The participant reached the private weekly review and must decide whether the ritual deserves continuation.
email_sequence.subject: Keep, change, or stop—without showing anyone
email_sequence.preview: Judge the private artifact by usefulness, burden, context and audience pressure.
email_sequence.body: Review the private card. Can you name one personally useful detail? Did capture feel lighter than the method you abandoned? What context did the constraint erase? Did any step make you imagine an audience? This synthetic exercise reports no personal outcome; your own bounded decision is the only next step.
email_sequence.cta: Choose another private week, a modified ritual, or a different memory category.
email_sequence.falsifier: Do not continue when the artifact is not personally useful or the ritual costs more attention than it preserves.

production_directions.concept: Seven ordinary traces remain visually private: a coffee ring, bus reflection, torn receipt edge, hallway light, fabric fold, half-heard sentence and rain mark.
production_directions.execution: Use quiet close-up photography, imperfect natural light, tactile surfaces, face-down cards and one blurred weekly artifact; each frame preserves an ordinary detail without turning it into lifestyle aspiration.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: Instagram uses a five-slide privacy diagnostic; TikTok thumbnails use one object and no face; search diagrams compare private card, journal, shared album and automatic log by effort, context and audience.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid grief bait, childhood nostalgia defaults, perfect morning routines, inspirational typography, public reveal mechanics, streak badges, and idealized influencer interiors.
production_directions.acceptance_test: A source-hidden viewer can identify the one-detail action and the privacy choice without assuming the artifact must be shared.

production_directions.concept: Your day does not need a documentary: a blank journal closes and one ordinary detail becomes the entire action.
production_directions.execution: Open on the hesitation before a blank page, cut to one tiny private mark, let seven incomplete frames accumulate behind a privacy screen, and keep the weekly artifact face-down at the ending.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: TikTok uses a twelve-second behavioral demonstration; Instagram Reels slows the private choice into three tactile cuts; YouTube examines low effort, lost context and optional sharing across four chapters.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid before-and-after transformation, countdown urgency, public reaction shots, sentimental montage, reward animation, and any implication that seven days proves sustained value.
production_directions.acceptance_test: After one muted viewing, a viewer can reproduce the action, state that sharing is optional, and name one reason to reject the ritual.

production_directions.concept: An intimate non-performative soundscape built from one room tone and one ordinary sound per day.
production_directions.execution: Use close, unpolished environmental sounds, warm but unsentimental narration, long pauses, and no musical resolution when the private card appears; the disclosure remains spoken rather than hidden in text.
production_directions.platform_adaptations: Short video uses one sentence and one diegetic sound; YouTube uses a sparse chapter palette; an audio reflection prompt remains optional and never requests a public voice note.
production_directions.avoid: Avoid loss-aversion music, emotional swells, whisper manipulation, simulated user diaries, streak sounds, notification pings, and a triumphant final chord.
production_directions.acceptance_test: An audio-only listener can repeat the one-detail rule, the missed-day rule, the privacy choice, and the synthetic no-effect boundary.

seven_day_flight.decision_after_observation: Repair intent coverage when the route produces curiosity without a bounded decision.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: One ordinary object and a no-documentary line will retain more relevant attention than a sentimental memory montage.
experiment_registry.numerator: eligible viewers who can reproduce the private one-detail action
experiment_registry.denominator: eligible complete exposures after bot and repeat-view filtering
experiment_registry.minimum_sample_rule: Freeze an authorized recent creative baseline and comprehension rubric before release.
experiment_registry.success_rule: Advance only when the pre-registered threshold is met without privacy or outcome misunderstanding.
experiment_registry.kill_rule: Stop when viewers remember mood or nostalgia but cannot reproduce the action.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: A private one-detail prompt will create more completed actions than a public sharing prompt without increasing audience pressure.
experiment_registry.numerator: authorized participants who report completing the action without sharing content
experiment_registry.denominator: eligible participants exposed to the complete instruction
experiment_registry.minimum_sample_rule: Register a privacy-preserving completion signal and baseline before collecting any observation.
experiment_registry.success_rule: Advance only when the threshold is met and no sensitive memory content is required or retained.
experiment_registry.kill_rule: Stop when participation depends on posting, streak pressure, or personal-content disclosure.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: A category trade-off map will produce more fit decisions than a feature explanation.
experiment_registry.numerator: eligible users who choose continue, modify, stop, or a named alternative category
experiment_registry.denominator: eligible users who complete the fit diagnostic
experiment_registry.minimum_sample_rule: Freeze the decision taxonomy, recent baseline and stopping condition before observation.
experiment_registry.success_rule: Advance only when the threshold is met and non-fit users are routed away correctly.
experiment_registry.kill_rule: Stop when the map increases interest but cannot produce a clear fit or non-fit decision.

experiment_registry.hypothesis: A private seven-day challenge may create stronger voluntary continuation intent than a streak-based onboarding ask.
experiment_registry.numerator: eligible participants choosing another private week after reviewing usefulness and burden
experiment_registry.denominator: eligible participants reaching the private weekly decision
experiment_registry.minimum_sample_rule: Register the continuation definition, privacy boundary, minimum sample and authorized recent route baseline before testing.
experiment_registry.success_rule: Advance only when the threshold is met without sharing pressure, guilt, or sensitive-content collection.
experiment_registry.kill_rule: Stop when continuation reflects obligation, streak recovery, or a missing alternative rather than artifact usefulness.
